posts.text: High temperatures and low precipitation in the American West last winter led to record-low snowpack. A study finds that such a snow drought is 4.4 times more likely in the current climate than it would have been in the pre-industrial climate. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/LKKh50ZtquX

posts.text: Human-elephant conflict is projected to rise across Southern Africa as human populations grow, cropland expands, and climate-driven aridity increases. New hotspot maps could help guide land-use planning and mitigation efforts. In PNAS Nexus: https://ow.ly/rjNt50ZtxAk

Researchers in #ScienceAdvances have created an engineered living material based on a filamentous fungus.

The material can regenerate its surface, self-clean, and integrate engineered microbial “partners” that can color the material or provide it with UV protection. https://scim.ag/4bY0PUG
posts.external_title: A programmable fungal platform for engineered living textiles
posts.external_description: A programmable fungal platform enables engineered living textiles with tunable functions and biodegradability.
